W. H. Hudson, The Purple Land.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/w-h-hudson/the-purple-land

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- W. H. Hudson, the author and the writer of the preface, died 1922 (Wikidata Q1359140, P570 = 1922-08-18).

First publication of the text used: 1885 (SE colophon: 'The Purple Land was published in 1885 by W. H. Hudson.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The text was first published in 1885, before 1931, so it entered the United States public domain 95 years after publication, in 1980.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and it does not change the result. Every person named above died in 1922 or earlier, the last being W. H. Hudson in 1922. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life plus 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
